props.name: size
props.description: The size of the number field.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the input.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text shown below the input.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown when invalid.

props.name: hideStepper
props.description: Whether to hide the stepper buttons.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Position of the label relative to the input.

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Text alignment for side labels.

props.name: necessityIndicator
props.description: Whether required fields show an icon or text label.

props.name: prefix
props.description: An icon or text rendered before the input.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the number field.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler for blur events.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the value changes.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Handler for copy events.

props.name: onCut
props.description: Handler for cut events.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler for focus events.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Handler for key down events.

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Handler for key up events.

props.name: onPaste
props.description: Handler for paste events.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The element ID that describes the number field.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: An accessible label for the number field.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The element ID that labels the number field.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the number field is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto-focus the input.

props.name: form
props.description: The form element this input belongs to.

props.name: name
props.description: The name for the form input.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: step
props.description: The step value for increment/decrement.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler called when focus state changes.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale for number formatting.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled).

props.name: minValue
props.description: The minimum value.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The maximum value.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the number field is read-only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the number field is required.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the number field is invalid.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Number format options.
